mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 1500 units signals increased consumer confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% indicates tightening monetary conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: low unemployment rates (UNRATE) below 4.5% are associated with strong labor markets, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of periods despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Interaction-driven: when industrial production (INDPRO) growth exceeds 2% YoY and simultaneously, the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is above 2.5%, this signals a strong supply-side expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances despite positive signal, or Rank IC < 0.025 over any 2-year rolling window.
